class.name: TrainElectricSeriesEngine
class.brief_description: Subclass of TrainElectricEngine. Adds additional parameters for more specific engines

members.member: [code]RList:DynBrakeRes[/code] Resistance of the resistors during ED (dynamic) braking, for two motors combined, in ohms.
[code]RList:DynBrakeRes1[/code] Primary ED braking resistance on the third stage, when it has two resistance levels, in ohms.
[code]RList:DynBrakeRes2[/code] ED braking resistance used at low speeds on the third stage, when it has two resistance levels, in ohms.
[code]RList:RVentCutOff[/code] Starting resistor value below which the cooling fans stop running (used when [member fan_type] is Automatic).
[code]RList:RVentnmax[/code] Maximum rotation speed of the starting resistor cooling fans.
[code]RList:RVentMinI[/code] Minimum current, in amperes, at which the cooling fans switch on.
[code]RList:RVentSpeed[/code] Cooling fan spin-up rate, in the range 0..1.
[code]RList:RVent[/code] How the starting resistor cooling fans are driven: not present, always on, or automatically controlled.
[code]Engine:nmax[/code] Maximum allowed motor rotation speed, in RPM.
[code]Engine:Volt[/code] Rated voltage of the motor, in volts
[code]RList[/code] Automatic starting sequence table: for each resistor-start controller position (starting from 1, not counting position 0), the starting resistance and motor branch configuration.
